Again, I notice another intersection with the straight line segment $CD$. This time, the intersection occurs to the right of point $C$ on the line. My directive is to remain on the *same smooth curve*, so I maintain my trajectory along the spiral, acknowledging this second crossing.

The curve then continues to loop around at the top of the inner section of the spiral, still maintaining its clockwise progression.

A third intersection with the straight line segment $CD$ occurs as I complete this inner loop.

Finally, as I follow this unbroken, continuous path, my tracing naturally leads me to point $A$, which I had previously identified as the inner endpoint of the spiral. 1. Start at point **$B$** at the top-left.
2. Follow the curve clockwise as it arches to the right and goes downward.
3. Pass straight through the first intersection with the straight line segment $CD$ (on the right side).
4. Continue following the loop around the bottom and back up towards the left.
5. Pass straight through the second intersection with the line segment $CD$.
6. Follow the inner loop as it curves clockwise at the top and heads downward.
7. Pass straight through the third intersection with the line segment $CD$ to reach the endpoint **$A$**.

Therefore, the endpoint reached is $\boxed{A}$.
